definitions: A condition experienced by Scrabble players where, after playing for an extended period, they start to see words everywhere in their environment, even in random patterns or objects.
The visual phenomenon of perceiving potential Scrabble words in everyday surroundings due to prolonged engagement with the game.
examples: After three hours of intense play, she started to get Scrabble eye, seeing 'xylophone' in the pattern of the wallpaper.
He knew he had Scrabble eye when the arrangement of books on the shelf looked like a high-scoring word.
The Scrabble eye made him pause, wondering if 'quixotic' could be spelled out by the clouds.
